SELECT COALESCE(PL2.VENDOR_NAME, 'Total') AS VENDOR_NAME , COALESCE(PL2.VENDOR_CODE::TEXT, '') AS VENDOR_CODE , PL2.DIVISION_CODE , CASE WHEN PL2.VENDOR_NAME IS NOT NULL AND D.DIVISION_NAME IS NULL THEN 'Sub Total' ELSE D.DIVISION_NAME END AS DIVISION_NAME , PL2.TOTAL_CNT , PL2.COO_GET_CNT , PL2.IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN , TRUNC(PL2.COO_GET_RATE * 100, 2) AS COO_GET_RATE FROM ( SELECT V.VENDOR_NAME , MAX(PL.VENDOR_CODE) AS VENDOR_CODE , MAX(PL.COMPANY_CODE) AS COMPANY_CODE , PL.DIVISION_CODE , PL.IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN , COUNT(PL.ITEM_CODE) AS TOTAL_CNT , SUM( CASE WHEN PL.COO_GET_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS COO_GET_CNT , SUM( CASE WHEN PL.COO_GET_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(PL.ITEM_CODE), 0) AS COO_GET_RATE FROM ( SELECT PL.ITEM_CODE , PL.VENDOR_CODE , PL.DIVISION_CODE , PL.COMPANY_CODE , V.IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN , SUM(PL.WAREHOUSING_QTY) AS WAREHOUSING_QTY , MAX( CASE WHEN ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS = '4' AND PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) AS COO_GET_YN FROM PO_LEDGER PL
INNER JOIN ITEM_DTL ID ON ID.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE AND ID.DIVISION_CODE = PL.DIVISION_CODE AND ID.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE -- AND ID.MAIL_SEND_YN = 'Y'
INNER JOIN VENDOR V ON V.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE AND V.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE -- AND V.MAIL_SEND_YN = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM ON ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO = PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO AND ECM.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE AND ECM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND PL.DIVISION_CODE = CASE WHEN ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'C' THEN PL.DIVISION_CODE ELSE ECM.DIVISION_CODE END
WHERE PL.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE BETWEEN #{search_from_date} AND #{search_to_date} AND PL.WAREHOUSING_TYPE IN ( 'DOM', 'IMP', 'RKWA' )
AND PL.VENDOR_CODE = #{vendor}
AND PL.DIVISION_CODE = #{plant}
GROUP BY PL.ITEM_CODE , PL.VENDOR_CODE , PL.DIVISION_CODE , PL.COMPANY_CODE , V.IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN ) PL
INNER JOIN VENDOR V ON PL.COMPANY_CODE = V.COMPANY_CODE AND PL.VENDOR_CODE = V.VENDOR_CODE
INNER JOIN DIVISION D ON PL.COMPANY_CODE = D.COMPANY_CODE AND PL.DIVISION_CODE = D.DIVISION_CODE
WHERE PL.WAREHOUSING_QTY > 0
GROUP BY ROLLUP( V.VENDOR_NAME , PL.DIVISION_CODE , PL.IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN ) ) PL2
LEFT JOIN DIVISION D ON PL2.COMPANY_CODE = D.COMPANY_CODE AND PL2.DIVISION_CODE = D.DIVISION_CODE
ORDER BY PL2.VENDOR_NAME , PL2.DIVISION_CODE

WITH BASE_LEDGER AS ( /* 조회 기간 내 입고된 대상 품목 및 증명서 */ SELECT PL.COMPANY_CODE , PL.VENDOR_CODE , PL.DIVISION_CODE , PL.ITEM_CODE , PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO , V.IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN , SUM(PL.WAREHOUSING_QTY) AS WAREHOUSING_QTY FROM PO_LEDGER PL
INNER JOIN ITEM_DTL ID ON ID.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND ID.DIVISION_CODE = PL.DIVISION_CODE AND ID.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE
INNER JOIN VENDOR V ON V.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND V.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE
WHERE PL.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE BETWEEN #{search_from_date} AND #{search_to_date} AND PL.WAREHOUSING_TYPE IN ('DOM', 'IMP', 'RKWA')
AND PL.VENDOR_CODE = #{vendor}
AND PL.DIVISION_CODE = #{plant}
GROUP BY PL.COMPANY_CODE , PL.VENDOR_CODE , PL.DIVISION_CODE , PL.ITEM_CODE , PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO , V.IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN
HAVING SUM(PL.WAREHOUSING_QTY) > 0 ),
BASE_ITEM AS ( /* 수취율 계산 대상 품목 */ SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_CODE , VENDOR_CODE , DIVISION_CODE , ITEM_CODE , IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN FROM BASE_LEDGER ),
FTA_LIST AS ( /* 전체 협정 목록 */ SELECT DISTINCT FTA_CODE FROM EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND FTA_CODE IS NOT NULL ),
VALID_CERT AS ( /* 제출 완료된 유효 증명서 */ SELECT DISTINCT BL.COMPANY_CODE , BL.VENDOR_CODE , BL.DIVISION_CODE , BL.ITEM_CODE , BL.COO_CERTIFY_NO FROM BASE_LEDGER BL
INNER JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM ON ECM.COMPANY_CODE = BL.COMPANY_CODE AND ECM.VENDOR_CODE = BL.VENDOR_CODE AND ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO = BL.COO_CERTIFY_NO AND ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS = '4' AND BL.DIVISION_CODE = CASE WHEN ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'C' THEN BL.DIVISION_CODE ELSE ECM.DIVISION_CODE END
WHERE BL.COO_CERTIFY_NO IS NOT NULL ),
ITEM_RECEIPT AS ( /* * 품목 수취 여부 * 역내·비역내 여부와 관계없이 유효 증명서가 있으면 수취 */ SELECT BI.COMPANY_CODE , BI.VENDOR_CODE , BI.DIVISION_CODE , BI.ITEM_CODE , BI.IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM VALID_CERT VC WHERE VC.COMPANY_CODE = BI.COMPANY_CODE AND VC.VENDOR_CODE = BI.VENDOR_CODE AND VC.DIVISION_CODE = BI.DIVISION_CODE AND VC.ITEM_CODE = BI.ITEM_CODE ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS COO_GET_YN FROM BASE_ITEM BI ),
ITEM_FTA_RESULT AS ( /* * 품목 × 전체 협정 * * 유효 증명서의 COO_YN = 'Y'가 있으면 역내 * COO_YN = 'N'이거나 협정 미수취이면 비역내 대상으로 계산 */ SELECT BI.COMPANY_CODE , BI.VENDOR_CODE , BI.DIVISION_CODE , BI.ITEM_CODE , BI.IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN , FL.FTA_CODE , CASE WHEN MAX( CASE WHEN ECD.COO_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ORIGIN_YN FROM BASE_ITEM BI
CROSS JOIN FTA_LIST FL
LEFT JOIN VALID_CERT VC ON VC.COMPANY_CODE = BI.COMPANY_CODE AND VC.VENDOR_CODE = BI.VENDOR_CODE AND VC.DIVISION_CODE = BI.DIVISION_CODE AND VC.ITEM_CODE = BI.ITEM_CODE
LEFT JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL ECD ON ECD.COMPANY_CODE = VC.COMPANY_CODE AND ECD.VENDOR_CODE = VC.VENDOR_CODE AND ECD.DIVISION_CODE = VC.DIVISION_CODE AND ECD.ITEM_CODE = VC.ITEM_CODE AND ECD.COO_CERTIFY_NO = VC.COO_CERTIFY_NO AND ECD.FTA_CODE = FL.FTA_CODE
GROUP BY BI.COMPANY_CODE , BI.VENDOR_CODE , BI.DIVISION_CODE , BI.ITEM_CODE , BI.IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN , FL.FTA_CODE ),
RECEIPT_SUMMARY AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ITEM_CNT
, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE COO_GET_YN = 'Y' ) AS RECEIVED_ITEM_CNT
, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN = 'Y' ) AS IMPORTANCE_ITEM_CNT
, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN = 'Y' AND COO_GET_YN = 'Y' ) AS IMPORTANCE_RECEIVED_ITEM_CNT FROM ITEM_RECEIPT ),
FTA_SUMMARY AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ITEM_FTA_CNT
, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE ORIGIN_YN = 'N' ) AS NON_ORIGIN_ITEM_FTA_CNT
, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN = 'Y' ) AS IMPORTANCE_ITEM_FTA_CNT
, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN = 'Y' AND ORIGIN_YN = 'N' ) AS IMPORTANCE_NON_ORIGIN_ITEM_FTA_CNT FROM ITEM_FTA_RESULT )
SELECT /* 총 구매처 수취율: 역내·비역내 관계없이 증명서 수취 여부 */ COALESCE( TRUNC( RS.RECEIVED_ITEM_CNT::NUMERIC / NULLIF(RS.TOTAL_ITEM_CNT, 0) * 100 , 2) , 0) AS TOTAL_COO_GET_RATE
/* 비역내 수취율: 비역내 협정 + 미수취 협정 */ , COALESCE( TRUNC( FS.NON_ORIGIN_ITEM_FTA_CNT::NUMERIC / NULLIF(FS.TOTAL_ITEM_FTA_CNT, 0) * 100 , 2) , 0) AS NON_ORIGIN_RATE
/* 집중대상 수취율 */ , COALESCE( TRUNC( RS.IMPORTANCE_RECEIVED_ITEM_CNT::NUMERIC / NULLIF(RS.IMPORTANCE_ITEM_CNT, 0) * 100 , 2) , 0) AS IMPORTANCE_COO_GET_RATE
/* 집중대상 비역내 수취율 */ , COALESCE( TRUNC( FS.IMPORTANCE_NON_ORIGIN_ITEM_FTA_CNT::NUMERIC / NULLIF(FS.IMPORTANCE_ITEM_FTA_CNT, 0) * 100 , 2) , 0) AS IMPORTANCE_NON_ORIGIN_RATE
FROM RECEIPT_SUMMARY RS CROSS JOIN FTA_SUMMARY FS

SELECT PL.ITEM_CODE , IM.ITEM_NAME , PL.VENDOR_CODE , V.VENDOR_NAME , PL.DIVISION_CODE , D.DIVISION_NAME , PL.COMPANY_CODE , SUM(PL.WAREHOUSING_QTY) AS WAREHOUSING_QTY , MAX( CASE WHEN ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS = '4' AND PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) AS COO_GET_YN , ECM.APPLY_DATE || '~' || ECM.END_DATE AS yyyymmdd FROM PO_LEDGER PL
INNER JOIN DIVISION D ON D.DIVISION_CODE = PL.DIVISION_CODE AND D.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE
INNER JOIN ITEM_DTL ID ON ID.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE AND ID.DIVISION_CODE = PL.DIVISION_CODE AND ID.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE -- AND ID.MAIL_SEND_YN = 'Y'
INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.ITEM_CODE = ID.ITEM_CODE AND IM.COMPANY_CODE = ID.COMPANY_CODE
INNER JOIN VENDOR V ON V.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE AND V.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE -- AND V.MAIL_SEND_YN = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM ON ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO = PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO AND ECM.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE AND ECM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND PL.DIVISION_CODE = CASE WHEN ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'C' THEN PL.DIVISION_CODE ELSE ECM.DIVISION_CODE END
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM JSONB_TO_RECORDSET( CAST(#{conditionListJson} AS JSONB) ) AS C( vendor_code TEXT, division_code TEXT ) WHERE C.vendor_code = PL.VENDOR_CODE AND C.division_code = PL.DIVISION_CODE )
AND PL.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE BETWEEN #{START_DATE} AND #{END_DATE} AND PL.WAREHOUSING_TYPE IN ('DOM', 'IMP', 'RKWA')
GROUP BY PL.ITEM_CODE , IM.ITEM_NAME , PL.VENDOR_CODE , V.VENDOR_NAME , PL.DIVISION_CODE , D.DIVISION_NAME , PL.COMPANY_CODE , ECM.APPLY_DATE , ECM.END_DATE
HAVING SUM(PL.WAREHOUSING_QTY) > 0
